Delton Technology.why: Server PCB maker: server PCBs are its main application and it serves 8 of the global top-10 server makers; revenue grows with CPU / AI server builds
Delton Technology.evidence: Delton Technology IR activity record: 2026-07 (09-15-2026): server PCBs are the company's main application, used in HPC, AI, storage servers and switches; it covers 8 of the global top-10 server manufacturers

players.product: Server PCBs (high-layer-count, high-speed boards for general-purpose and AI servers supporting Intel, AMD and Arm CPUs; PCIe 6.0 server PCBs in small-volume ramp), plus accelerator-card, optical-module and switch PCBs

quarterly_data.signal: Management (H1 2026 results briefing, IR record): server PCBs are the company's main application and account for a high share of PCB revenue, used in HPC servers, AI servers, storage servers and switches; the company has long-term relationships with leading global server brands and EMS makers, covering 8 of the global top-10 server manufacturers, and is pushing core-customer certifications ahead of volume orders (customer names are confidential).
quarterly_data.figure: 8 of the global top-10 server manufacturers

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): capacity from the Guangzhou plant retrofit, Yunqing smart manufacturing base phase I, a new round of equipment at the Thailand base, the Dongguan Machong plant and Yunqing phase II will be released progressively from Q3 between 2026 and 2028; the Thailand plant's new round of construction is on track to add capacity in Q4 2026 and has not been materially affected by the rainy season or flood warnings so far.
quarterly_data.figure: Capacity release 2026-2028; Thailand new capacity Q4 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the company negotiated price increases with downstream customers for higher raw-material costs, executed progressively in Q2; pricing differs by customer and project and includes periodic negotiation and price-linkage arrangements for commodities such as copper. Management said its fundamental response to the pressure is raising product value-add rather than relying on price pass-through.
